arguments.question: For NVDA's 21/63-session outlook, is there a current monetary-policy channel through AI-infrastructure financing conditions that is likely material? Please distinguish policy facts from any company-specific sensitivity; NVIDIA's Aug. 10 issuer release says planned customer financing platforms are subject to final agreements but gives no rate sensitivity.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines whether to treat rates as a quantified earnings transmission or only an unquantified macro/valuation risk in the NVDA draft.
